repository.head_advance_scope: One external commit adding only reports/v6-phase10-execution-baseline.json (the approved P10-S0 output). No source, test, protected artifact or accepted report changed.
repository.untracked_note: The single untracked file at audit start was the approved P10-S0 output. It was committed externally as 8f9a044 during the audit; the working tree is clean again.
repository.dependency_note: Static import analysis found no non-stdlib imports outside the server package itself. The server is pure standard-library Python.

critical_gaps.title: No installable distribution
critical_gaps.detail: The server cannot be installed with pip and has no entry point or clean-environment test. This directly contradicts the installation requirement.

critical_gaps.title: No multi-client configuration evidence
critical_gaps.detail: Only one VS Code style snippet exists; no real client connection has been recorded.

critical_gaps.title: Live AI still unproven
critical_gaps.detail: Zero successful live responses. Blocked by governance, not by code.

critical_gaps.title: Engine import/build tool paths unverified
critical_gaps.detail: Unity batch refresh, test and build tools are marked implemented-unverified; Godot is untestable here; Unreal is staging-only.

critical_gaps.title: Operating-system and client matrix absent
critical_gaps.detail: Only Windows 11 has evidence; Linux and macOS must remain NOT_TESTED.

critical_gaps.title: Documentation set incomplete
critical_gaps.detail: Eleven required user-facing documents do not exist as standalone guides.

critical_gaps.title: No CI or reproducible release automation
critical_gaps.detail: No workflow file exists; nothing enforces the suite on change.

critical_gaps.title: MCP protocol surface incomplete
critical_gaps.detail: Cancellation notification unhandled; resources and prompts are empty placeholders; malformed-input and concurrency tests are thin.

security_and_reliability_risks.risk: OS-level socket/DNS cancellation remains unproven; hung resolver threads may persist.
Windows-centric path and executable assumptions may fail on POSIX.
Empty resources/prompts handlers could mislead clients into expecting capabilities.
Credential leakage through provider error strings.
Unverified engine tooling could be mistaken for working builds.
Stale provider catalogue treated as current.
No CI means regressions are invisible between manual runs.

required_future_approval_gates.scope: Commit, push, tag, publish or release
MCP reliability fixes and regression tests

recommended_next_stage.name: MCP reliability and protocol conformance
recommended_next_stage.reason: It is local, requires no credentials, no network and no engine, and it unblocks packaging and client compatibility. P10-S1 can run in parallel only if separately approved.
scope_preview: Add malformed-input, oversized-frame, concurrency and shutdown tests
Decide whether to implement cancellation notifications or document the limitation
Decide whether resources/prompts stay empty or get real content
Add per-tool invocation smoke tests for uncovered tool categories
Fix any defect found, with regression tests

what_is_genuinely_working: Pure-stdlib MCP server with 107 real tools and 107 handlers.
515 passing offline tests at the audited commit.
Deterministic understanding, specification, orchestration and verification.
Free-only provider policy with quota accounting and no paid fallback.
Real Blender character and environment pipelines that produced inspectable assets.
A real Unity 6000.6.2f1 Windows build that completed a scripted playthrough (historical evidence).
Security controls with 12 passing automated checks.
what_must_not_be_claimed: Unreal import or build is supported.
Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code or OpenCode client compatibility.
The product is production-ready or released.
